create_iteration_statistics: create an IterationStatistics instance to store iteration-specific metrics as key-to-list mappings
append_metrics_to_statistics: append a dictionary of key-value metric pairs to an IterationStatistics instance
initialize_data_lists: initialize an empty IterationStatistics object with a data_lists dictionary attribute
record_episode_returns: record per-episode returns by appending train_episode_returns values to IterationStatistics
accumulate_iteration_metrics: accumulate multiple metric key-value pairs across episodes using IterationStatistics.append
